scenes.title: Ab Koi Tang Nahi Karega
narration: *Panchami ki dopahar. College canteen mein chai ke kulhad, samosa ki khushboo aur Puja ki chhuttiyon ka shor. Bahar se dhaak ki door-door se aawaz aa rahi hai.*
*Kal isi canteen mein senior Rocky Sen ne tumhe line se dhakka diya tha — 'Eh cycle-wala, peeche ja' — aur sab hase the. Aaj Rocky ki table khaali hai. Uske dost tumhe dekh ke nazar chura rahe hain.*

*Achanak canteen mein sannata chha jaata hai. Darwaze par Sitara Ghosh khadi hai — kaali leather jacket, kamar tak lambe wavy baal, sunglasses baalon mein atke hue, gale mein ek chain pe latakta neela pen. Peeche ek pahaad jaisa bodyguard, Bhola.*
*Woh seedha tumhari table pe aati hai, Tublu ko ek nazar dekhti hai — Tublu apni plate lekar khud hi doosri table pe chala jaata hai — aur dhamm se tumhare bagal mein baith jaati hai.*

Sitara Ghosh: "Kal kisi ne mere pen-wale ko dhakka diya tha, suna maine." *Woh apni plate se ek garam samosa uthati hai aur tumhari plate mein rakh deti hai.* "Ab koi tang nahi karega, jaan. Kabhi nahi."
*Phir woh samosa ka ek tukda todti hai, phoonk maarti hai, aur tumhare muh ke paas le aati hai. Poora canteen saans roke dekh raha hai.*
Sitara Ghosh: "Muh kholo. Aur haan — subah se mere unees messages ka reply nahi aaya. Unees! Bhola ne bataya tum library mein the. Library mein network nahi hota kya, haan?"
*Uska phone bajta hai. Screen pe likha hai: BABA. Woh do second sunti hai, phir phone tumhari taraf ghuma deti hai, aankhon mein shararat aur thodi si ghabrahat dono.*

Sitara Ghosh: "Baba ne tumhe aaj raat dinner pe bulaya hai. Ghar pe. Unhe tumse 'aaram se baat' karni hai." *Woh tumhara haath apne dono haathon mein le leti hai.* "Darr mat, jaan. Main hoon na. ...Waise tum aaoge na? Bolo na."
fallbackLines: *Sitara thodi pe haath tikaaye tumhe dekhti rehti hai jaise duniya mein aur kuch hai hi nahi. Peeche Bhola apni ghadi dekhta hai aur halka sa khaansta hai.*
Sitara Ghosh: "Itna sharmaate ho na, mujhe aur zyada pyaar aata hai. Ye galat baat hai, jaan."

choices.text: *Ghabrahat chhupa kar haan bol dena — dinner pe aaunga.*

memory: On Panchami {{playerName}} agreed to go to dinner at Shankar Dada's house.

choices.text: *Dheere se poochna — 'Rocky aaj aaya kyun nahi? Tumne kuch kiya?'*

memory: On Panchami {{playerName}} asked Sitara what happened to Rocky Sen.

choices.text: *Chupchaap uske haath se samosa kha lena — sharma kar, poore canteen ke saamne.*

memory: On Panchami {{playerName}} let Sitara feed him a samosa in front of the whole canteen.
